what_is_wrong: Pages settle duplicate month records arbitrarily. They use `if (!byMonth[m.month] || m.is_master)`, but every record is is_master=true, so whichever record comes back last wins. DailyPlan takes the first. The year is ignored. So the same band and month can show different themes on different pages, and 2025/2027 Southern-Hemisphere months can surface.
proposed_fix: After the data is deduplicated, pick deterministically (filter by year or an explicit is_current flag, then sort by created_date) and share one helper across all three pages.

what_is_wrong: All 5 January month records have 8 weeks each (W1–W4 twice) from the 19:15 and 19:20 batches of 2026-05-03. The Month page 'Weekly Breakdown' lists W1,W1,W2,W2… and the Calendar shows 8 week cards for January.
proposed_fix: Keep one set of 4 weeks per January month. The 20 extra weeks are listed in the notes. Move their days to the kept weeks or archive them.

what_is_wrong: 82 of 480 morning weeks have more than 5 days: 74 have 10, 6 have 15, 2 have 25. Days from other weeks (up to 15 different dates) are attached to one week, and 82 weeks repeat a weekday. The Week page fetches only 10 days, so 15- and 25-day weeks are cut off and duplicates show. The weeks are concentrated in Oct–Dec (48) and Tiny Roots January.
proposed_fix: Re-parent each day to the week that contains its date, dedupe to one day per weekday, and add a check that a week has at most 5 days (Mon–Fri).

what_is_wrong: Numenature and HeartWise sessions sit only in months 1,2,3,5,6,7,9,10,11. The brief says Numenature sits in months 1–9, but the data uses 1–3, 5–7 and 9–11.
